canonical_project: Swakopmund Equiano Cable Landing Station (Telecom Namibia / Paratus)
owner: Telecom Namibia and Paratus Group (for Google Equiano)
notes: Swakopmund, Erongo; Equiano landed 2022-07-01; CLS co-built by Telecom Namibia and Paratus (building completed Sep 2021, internal fit Jan 2022), switched on June 2023; station inaugurated 2024-07-31 with 100G link to Johannesburg; WACS also lands at Swakopmund; SARSSy to interconnect via this station. Cable landing station, NOT customer colocation - recorded separately per methodology.
